artworks.title: Saint Helen
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a woman standing in a dignified pose at the center. She has long hair, a calm expression, and a halo above her head. She wears a long gown with a shawl and holds a staff. Several cherubs surround her, with classical architectural elements in the background.

artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Erasmus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate scene with historical and religious elements. The image depicts a crowned figure seated on a throne, surrounded by individuals in robes. In the foreground, a man is lying on a table, and above him, a mechanism is being operated by others. To the right of the throne, an angel-like figure is depicted within a circular form. The drawing is monochromatic and uses detailed line work and hatching to provide depth and texture to the figures and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing in an architectural niche, with one foot slightly in front of the other. The person has an aged appearance, a long beard, and hair that reaches the nape of their neck. They wear a flowing robe and hold a sword in their right hand. A simple arch design with light hatching patterns is behind them, and there is a faint halo around their head. The background is plain, with no other objects or characters present.

artworks.title: The Ascension
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial ascension scene. The image depicts a central figure in flowing robes ascending amidst a radiance of light, surrounded by clouds and angels. Beneath this figure, there are a group of other figures, some with veils, gathered around. Each figure seems to have unique expressions. This work captures intricate details in the folds of garments and the expressions of the figures.

artworks.title: Paradise
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious assembly. Numerous figures are depicted draped in flowing robes, engaging in discussion or prayer. The figures are arranged in tiers, some sitting, others standing, many holding open books. Rays of light descend from the sky, with symbols like clouds, an unfinished dome, a cross, and scales. The atmosphere evokes a sense of spiritual gathering, with figures seemingly venerating or receiving divine instruction. The intricate lines and detailed etching style suggest a classical influence, capturing a complex interplay of characters and heavenly elements.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child with Saints James and Jerome
artworks.description: The image shows three figures and a child seated. The central figure is a woman with a child on her lap. The child has one hand raised. The woman wears a veil and flowing robes and is seated on an ornate chair. Two men stand on either side. One holds a staff and an open book, with a contemplative expression. The other man holds a closed book and gestures towards the woman and child. Each adult figure has a halo. A detailed wall is behind them.

artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Stephen
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 11.7 × 7.9 cm (4 5/8 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people engaged in a religious scene. The drawing depicts a densely packed group of figures in a historical or biblical setting. In the foreground, several figures are kneeling or standing, some with their hands raised. The scene takes place outdoors, in front of buildings with domes and arches visible in the background. Above the group, the sky is filled with clouds and what appear to be angelic or divine figures. The atmosphere is solemn and dramatic, with intricate line work detailing the expressions and attire of the figures.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.4 × 8.9 cm (4 7/8 × 3 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a group of ancient soldiers reacting to a heavenly event above them. The soldiers below appear surprised and in motion, with some on horseback and others shielding against an unknown force. In the sky above, figures are depicted surrounded by clouds, suggesting a supernatural presence. The drawing contrasts the turmoil below with the calm celestial realm above, using strong lines and high contrast for a dynamic composition.

artworks.title: Sapphira Punished by Death
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.8 × 8.5 cm (5 1/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural scene with several figures. The composition includes a group of figures, some elevated on a platform, while others stand or lie below. The figures are dressed in flowing robes. The architectural elements include columns with Corinthian capitals and a domed building in the background. The line work and use of hatching create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Fall of Simon the Magician
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8.8 cm (5 1/8 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an angelic figure descending from the sky above a gathering. The scene shows the figure descending from clouds with drapery and wings, casting light towards a group of figures below. The figures below are looking upwards in awe or reverence. The background features an architectural setting with pillars and rounded arches, suggesting a classical design. The drawing includes detailed linework for texture and depth, enhancing the dramatic and divine ambiance.

artworks.title: Peter Raising Tabitha
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.2 × 8.5 cm (4 13/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure seated with a group gathered around. The central figure is elevated, seated on steps, with one arm extended outward towards the surrounding figures. The figures are arranged around the central figure, some sitting, some standing, in various poses. The style is reminiscent of classical or Renaissance art, with a strong use of line and shading. The setting appears architectural, with steps and columns. Above, a group of cherub-like figures is visible in the clouds.

artworks.title: Peter and John Healing the Lame
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.8 × 8.6 cm (5 1/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of architectural elements with a scene unfolding beneath. The scene shows several figures gathered around a bearded central figure who appears to be granting or administering something to a person kneeling before him. The architecture includes tall columns and an archway in the background. Above the group, in the sky, is a cluster of figures and cherubs observing the event. The composition features intricate line work creating depth and texture, typical of engravings or etchings, and conveys movement and drama within the scene.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Peter
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.3 × 7.3 cm (4 7/16 × 2 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a central figure on stairs, with cherubic figures in clouds above. The scene is densely populated with figures involved in various activities or interactions, creating movement and drama. Architectural structures frame the background, suggesting a public and significant setting. The drawing is characterized by intricate line work and cross-hatching, providing depth and contrast, highlighting figures' clothing and expressions. The composition leads the eye toward the central staircase, emphasizing the significance of the actions taking place there, while the celestial figures in the clouds add a divine or mystical element to the scene.

artworks.title: Christ Walking on the Water [first plate]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.8 × 7.5 cm (4 5/8 × 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a celestial event with figures and rays of light. There are two prominent figures in the foreground, one reaching out to the other who is kneeling. Above them, a group of angelic beings is located on clouds, with rays of light descending towards the figures below. The scene is detailed with flowing garments and dynamic poses, capturing a moment of interaction in a dramatic and divine atmosphere. The style resembles Baroque engravings, with a focus on contrast, movement, and spiritual intensity.

artworks.title: Christ Walking on the Water [second plate]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11 × 7.7 cm (4 5/16 × 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene with figures on water. The composition features a group of figures on a small vessel, with heavenly light and clouds above. Some figures stand on the water, reaching out to each other. The artistry includes detailed cross-hatching for depth and shadow, especially in clothing and faces. The celestial imagery above includes angels and light, giving a divine presence. The drawing exhibits elements of Renaissance religious art styles, emphasizing movement and expression.

artworks.title: The Assumption
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.5 × 8.8 cm (4 15/16 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with a central figure ascending surrounded by light and clouds. Below, a group of individuals in flowing garments look up towards the ascending figure with expressions of awe or reverence. The drawing is detailed with shading, giving a sense of movement and depth. The style is influenced by religious art from the Renaissance period, known for intricate detailing and dramatic expression.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Instructing his Disciples in the Desert
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.5 × 8.7 cm (4 15/16 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of robed individuals surrounding a seated, partially clothed figure in a rocky landscape. The scene depicts figures within a cave-like setting. A cross leans against a rock beside the seated figure, who is holding an open book. The background shows hills, trees, and a building on a slope, all within a circular frame. The detailed line work and hatching create depth and texture in this monochromatic piece.

artworks.title: Saint Basil Celebrating the Mass
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.5 × 7.3 cm (4 1/2 × 2 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of robed figures in a domed chamber. Some figures are on steps leading to a raised platform. The room has tall columns and a chandelier with flames. The figures seem to be in a ceremonial activity, with one holding a book and another holding a staff. There are detailed linework on the garments and architecture, giving depth to the scene. In the background, more figures are passing by an open window showing a skyline. The use of hatching and cross-hatching creates light and shadow contrast in the composition.

artworks.title: Death of Saint Benedict
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12 × 7.8 cm (4 3/4 × 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with figures gathered beneath a heavenly vision. The scene depicts several figures, some seated and some standing, gazing upwards towards a group of angelic or saintly figures seated on clouds in a celestial realm. The composition includes an arch that frames the upper part of the image, where the divine or heavenly figures are shown amidst radiating beams of light. Beneath, on the earthly plane, additional figures, including those in clerical attire, are engaged in a religious ceremony or gathering. The drawing showcases flowing robes, varied textures, and the interaction between the earthly and the divine realms through expressive gestures and gazes.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18 × 12.5 cm (7 1/16 × 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a burial scene with multiple mourners surrounding a figure at a tomb. The central, reclining figure is lamented by the gathered individuals. In the background, three crosses stand on a distant hill. The drawing features rich line work, creating texture in the garments and expressions. The setting is outdoors with rolling hills and trees. Light and shadow are used for dramatic effect, emphasizing the emotional intensity of the composition.

artworks.title: Side Aisle of San Lorenzo, Florence
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.5 × 20 cm (9 1/4 × 7 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior. The room is decorated with ornate columns, drapery, heraldic shields, reliefs, framed artworks, statues, and altar-like structures with crosses. The drawing is detailed and ornate.

artworks.title: Façade of San Lorenzo, Florence
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 19 × 24.2 cm (7 1/2 × 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade adorned with mythical elements. The drawing features a highly detailed architectural structure with multiple levels, decorated with various ornamental elements such as columns, draperies, and statues. The facade includes figures resembling skeletons in dynamic poses across the tiers. There are elaborately carved pillars and arches, and the upper tier features a scene under a draped canopy showing a central figure seated, surrounded by additional skeletal figures. Each level of the structure is symmetrically designed with decorative motifs, typical of baroque architectural facades with artistic motifs.

artworks.title: The Catafalque
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26 × 13 cm (10 1/4 × 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural structure resembling a grand stage or altar. It includes a central platform, tall ornate columns, steps, a canopy, decorative elements, drapery, heraldic symbols, a globe, stylized figures, and engraved insignia. Candles or candlesticks are also present.

artworks.title: Entry into Ferrara [recto]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 18 cm (5 1/8 × 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession of figures on horseback. The scene portrays several horses and riders in a formal and ordered procession. The riders are wearing wide-brimmed hats and cloaks. The horses are well-detailed, with their bridles and reins distinctly drawn. Surrounding the riders are other figures, some marching on foot. In the background, a structure with arched openings sets the location as a structured environment. The style of the drawing exhibits fine line work, attention to intricate details, and a sense of age.
